guard_pose: low ready stance facing right, gripping a huge black notched greatsword at his hip, the long blade angled up and forward

jab: quick straight thrust: drives the huge black greatsword straight forward at full extension, then pulls it back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
jab2: diagonal slash: swings the huge black greatsword from high in front down to low in front in one fast cut, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
ftilt: big forward cut: lifts the huge black greatsword above his head and brings it straight down to low in front of him, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
utilt: overhead arc: sweeps the huge black greatsword from in front of him up over his head to behind him, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
dtilt: crouching low cut: drops into a crouch and sweeps the huge black greatsword low in front at shin height, then rises back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
dashattack: running slash: lunges forward with a long stride and swings the huge black greatsword across in a wide horizontal cut, then stops and settles back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
fsmash: charged smash: raises the huge black greatsword far behind his head, black anti-magic crackling like black lightning over the blade, then brings it down in a tremendous cut to the front, then recovers into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
usmash: rising smash: crouches, then swings the huge black greatsword in a big arc from in front straight up over his head, black anti-magic crackling like black lightning trailing the blade, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
dsmash: low spinning cut: slashes the huge black greatsword low in front, then spins around and slashes low behind him, black anti-magic crackling like black lightning, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
nair: double cut in mid-air: chops the huge black greatsword down in front of him, then swings it back up, the blade circling close around his body, then back to the tucked pose The whole blade stays inside the picture.
fair: crescent cut in mid-air: swings the huge black greatsword in a big arc from above his head down to below him in front, then back to the tucked pose The whole blade stays inside the picture.
bair: backward cut in mid-air: twists his torso and swings the huge black greatsword behind him in a downward arc, then back to the tucked pose The whole blade stays inside the picture.
uair: overhead arc in mid-air: swings the huge black greatsword from behind him over his head to the front, then back to the tucked pose The whole blade stays inside the picture.
dair: downward stab in mid-air: points the huge black greatsword straight down beneath him and plunges it down, then pulls it back up to the tucked pose The whole blade stays inside the picture.
ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low horizontal cut of the huge black greatsword forward at knee height, then back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
getupattack: from lying on his back, swings the huge black greatsword low across in front of him, then low behind him while springing to his feet, ending in the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.

nspecial: anti-magic slash: raises the huge black greatsword over his head with both hands as black anti-magic gathers on the blade, then cuts down to the front and a black crescent of anti-magic edged with white crackles flies off the blade straight forward, then he recovers into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
sspecial: Black Meteorite rush: crouches, then charges forward wrapped in a swirling black anti-magic aura with the greatsword thrust ahead, strikes three fast blows, then a final rising slash, then skids to a stop and settles back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
uspecial: Black Hurricane: crouches, then springs upward spinning like a drill, the greatsword whirling around him in a tight tornado of black anti-magic, ending in mid-air with the sword raised above his head, legs dangling
dspecial: anti-magic deflection: braces and holds the huge greatsword flat across in front of his body like a shield, black anti-magic flickering along the blade, holds the block for a moment, then swings it forward like a bat to send the spell back, then returns to the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.

w0_ultimate: Black Meteorite: wrapped in black anti-magic, he springs upward slashing upward with the Demon-Slayer Sword several times, then raises it over his head with both hands and plunges straight down like a black meteor, slamming the blade down in front of him with a burst of black anti-magic, then rises back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
w1_sspecial: Black Divider: crouches, then dashes forward at blinding speed wrapped in black anti-magic, slashing five times in quick succession, then one final rising cut, then skids to a stop and settles back into the stance The whole blade stays inside the picture.
